data.title: Brand favicon: PM-1 mark (charcoal badge, 3x3 pixel grid, orange center LED) + head wiring

data.body: Implemented by orchestrator: favicon.svg (hand-written, 16px geometry), favicon-32.png + apple-touch-icon.png (generated via throwaway zero-dep node PNG encoder in scratchpad, verified visually and via file(1)), index.html head wiring (png-first icon order for safari, svg for evergreens, apple-touch-icon, theme-color plastic, meta description in brand voice), BRANDING.md §2 app-mark definition. Build copies all three to dist/. Commit follows.

Reviewed commit 9e48da7 cold against the plan. favicon.svg: parsed every rect — 16x16 rx=3.5 charcoal badge, nine 3x3 cells at {2.5,6.5,10.5} on both axes, eight paper + center orange; exactly the three token hexes #1B1B1A/#FBFAF8/#FF4E00, nothing else. PNGs verified with a scratchpad node decoder (signature, IHDR, full IDAT unfilter — not just file(1)): favicon-32.png is 32x32 RGBA, all four corners alpha=0, center pixel #FF4E00, all eight outer cell centers #FBFAF8, margin charcoal; apple-touch-icon.png is 180x180, every pixel alpha=255, corners full-bleed charcoal, center orange, cell centers at margin-27/cells-34/gaps-12 geometry all paper. Render-checked both PNGs visually — they read as the described mark (charcoal badge, 3x3 paper grid, orange center LED). index.html head: PNG sizes=32x32 icon first, SVG type=image/svg+xml second, apple-touch-icon link, theme-color #E7E6E1, brand-voice description — all present, correct order. BRANDING.md section 2 app-mark bullet documents geometry and the same three hexes. npx tsc --noEmit clean; npm run build clean and all three assets land in dist/. No findings. Verdict: pass — meets all acceptance criteria.
